instruction: Please help me set the display language of VS Code to "Russian" without installing any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible in the OSWorld environment. VS Code's display language can only be changed to non-English languages through marketplace extensions. The restriction on extensions makes this task impossible to complete.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - VS Code requires language pack extensions to change display language to non-English languages like Russian
Instruction explicitly prohibits installing extensions, creating an impossible constraint
Using the 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate and semantically correct approach for tasks that cannot be completed
Metadata provides clear explanation of why the task is infeasible
